correctness.rationale: The 24 long D4 roots give a 24-vertex graph with 96 edges, pairwise graph distances counts (96,168,12) at distances (1,2,3), where only antipodes are at distance 3. Radius-one cliques are exactly the 96 triangle faces of the convex 24-cell: K1 is the 2-skeleton of its S3 boundary. Removing the interiors of 24 octahedral 3-facets gives wedge23 S2; cellular boundary d3 maps Z[24 facets] onto H2 with kernel the signed orientation sum. Thus the exact ZW lattice is determinant-twisted permutation quotient Z[F]/Zsum, not an integral augmentation kernel. Radius two is a join of twelve S0 pairs = S11; radius three is a simplex. The group action on 11-sphere equals determinant on W(F4). Independently regenerated all 24 roots, facets, triangles, reflection group of order 1152 and checked all 1152 character traces and cross-polytope orientation signs; H2 trace distribution {-11:12,-5:12,-1:597,1:444,3:54,5:32,23:1} and H11 +/-1 576 each as claimed. This is exact finite plus cellular geometric proof, not finite-field extrapolation.
residual_risks: Simple-homotopy assertion uses standard 3-manifold shell and 2-skeleton retraction; full external proof of all implications not sought. No integral irreducible decomposition beyond quotient lattice.
